finding: Synthetic Gamma Ray is synthesized directly from target facies labels (base_GR + Gaussian noise sigma=5).
scientific_consequence: Using synthetic GR as a feature in ML classifiers (XGBoost) creates direct label leakage. Predicting facies from GR achieves near-perfect accuracy artificially because GR is a noisy copy of the target label.
recommended_action: Exclude synthetic GR from all predictive feature matrices in primary model evaluation. Restrict GR strictly to synthetic petrophysical proxy demonstrations.

finding: prev_facies feature uses ground-truth facies shifted by 1 meter globally before train/test splitting, and evaluation feeds true prev_facies at test time.
scientific_consequence: Because sedimentary layers are continuous (average bed thickness 4-18m), knowing true facies at depth d-1 trivializes classification of facies at depth d. In real-world inference on unseen lithologs, true prev_facies is unavailable.
recommended_action: Remove prev_facies from baseline spatial evaluation. If sequential dependency is tested, use strict dynamic autoregressive roll-out starting from a single known boundary condition.

finding: Evaluation evaluates on full_df, which includes all training samples (X_test = full_df[['Depth', 'prev_facies']]).
scientific_consequence: Training data is evaluated as part of the test set, creating self-evaluation bias. Reported accuracy conflates training fit with out-of-sample generalization.
recommended_action: Enforce strict disjoint holdout splits (e.g. Leave-One-Litholog-Out). Never evaluate on training rows.

finding: Phase 1 Markov model is strictly a 1D vertical succession counter across all wells combined; it has zero spatial conditioning, coordinate awareness, or inter-well prediction capability.
scientific_consequence: The current Markov chain implementation cannot predict facies at an unmeasured spatial location or condition on neighboring lithologs. It cannot be used as a spatial reconstruction model in LOLO experiments without new spatial modeling implementation.
recommended_action: Clearly document in all project reports that Phase 1 Markov is a 1D vertical prior, not a spatial interpolator. Implement 2D conditional geostatistical algorithms (e.g. T-PROGS or MPS) in Phase 2/3.

finding: Planned Phase 2 (object_sim.py) and Phase 3 (conditional_grid.py) modules are completely absent from the codebase.
scientific_consequence: No bridge exists between 1D vertical Markov probabilities and 2D/3D spatial conditioning. Fluvial geometries (W/T=35) do not inform any grid model.
recommended_action: Acknowledge Phase 2 and 3 as unbuilt planned modules. Define mathematical coupling (e.g. coupled Markov chains or object rasterization) before implementation.

finding: Loader calculates strike_pos_m as (num - 1) * 100.0 from litholog number, overriding true spatial coordinates with artificial linear spacing.
scientific_consequence: True spatial layout (arcuate escarpment, canyon turns, non-monotonic ordering where L6 is west of L5 and L10 is south of L9) is replaced by false uniform spacing. Any 2D model trained on strike_pos_m learns distorted spatial geometry.
recommended_action: Deprecate synthetic strike_pos_m. Replace with real coordinates from Location_coordinates_lithologs.xlsx once CRS and units are verified.

finding: All logs start at numerical depth 0 at modern erosional cliff tops; no common stratigraphic datum (Star Point top or regional coal marker) is applied.
scientific_consequence: Treating equal numerical depth z across logs as equivalent geological time horizons creates cross-stratal smearing. Comparing logs at fixed numerical depths is geologically invalid.
recommended_action: Obtain elevation/datum offsets for each section from Prof. Sahoo. Flatten logs against Star Point Sandstone top before spatial correlation.

finding: Standardized tabular outputs (CSV and Parquet) omit provenance metadata columns, separating data points from their source-derived vs AI-reconstructed origin.
scientific_consequence: Downstream modeling scripts consuming processed tables cannot easily filter or weight observations by provenance without manually joining provenance_manifest.json.
recommended_action: Add provenance_category and independent_validation columns to processed schema in future non-breaking updates.

finding: encode_facies dictionary omits 'silt', causing all silt rows to map to NaN and be dropped by dropna(); in train_and_evaluate line 69 overwrites unmapped predictions with raw mapped predictions.
scientific_consequence: Facies classification in legacy litholog_model.py drops significant stratigraphic beds (siltstone) and contains dead/buggy prediction mapping code.
recommended_action: Retire legacy src/litholog_model.py or isolate it strictly as an archived demonstration script.

finding: Litholog 12 is a subsurface drill core (EM-137C); Blackhawk interval (0-111m) has been digitized into tabular CSV.
scientific_consequence: De-risked for 1D descriptive and Markov modeling across 0-111m interval; deeper 111-242m interval preserved as regional strata.
recommended_action: Digitized into standardized CSV data/raw_lithologs/litholog12.csv (63 contiguous beds).
